title: PH seeking best deals for agri, oil imports

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines will continue to diversify its sources of agricultural and energy imports despite US President Donald Trump’s claim that Manila had agreed to buy these products exclusively from the United States, officials said on Monday. Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. said the government would maintain multiple sources of farm commodities.
